|---|---|---|---|

The figures come from each company's FY2025 10-K. Wingstop's fiscal year ends 2025-12-27 rather than on December 31, so its period is a few days shorter than the others. If you wanted a simple average of the three margins instead of an aggregate, it would be about 24.4%.

text: I'll start by checking which operating income and revenue records exist for Chipotle (CMG) and Yum! Brands (YUM) in fiscal 2024.
The FY2024 10-K rows exist for both companies. Next I'll pull the actual FY2024 values, plus the filing and period details, to check for duplicates or restatements.

Chipotle and Yum! Brands together had a fiscal 2024 operating margin of about 22.9%, computed as combined operating income divided by combined revenue.

| Company | Operating income (USD) | Revenue (USD) | Margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chipotle (CMG) | 1,916,333,000 | 11,313,853,000 | 16.9% |
| Yum! Brands (YUM) | 2,403,000,000 | 7,549,000,000 | 31.8% |
